name: AccessCore Preflight
purpose: adapt IAM identity context and explicit domain-owned action/resource semantics to an asynchronous AccessCore decision boundary without implementing authorization policy

adapter.transport: dependency-injected; WebEngine does not invent an HTTP endpoint
adapter.invalidDecision: adapter failure; never coerced to allow or deny

subjectProjection.rule: anonymous identity is still submitted to AccessCore; WebEngine does not auto-deny it

mustNot: derive authorization from IAM management tier
infer authorization from DOM or presentation state

projectorPreflight.allow: mount renderer through canonical renderer lifecycle
projectorPreflight.deny: do not invoke renderer; publish projector lifecycle state denied
projectorPreflight.adapterFailure: publish projector lifecycle state error and propagate failure
projectorPreflight.rendererContext: allowed renderer receives identity context plus non-authoritative access presentation context

securityBoundary.rule: projector preflight is presentation gating only
securityBoundary.backend: the owning service that performs the protected action must enforce authorization at the actual action boundary

rules: AccessCore remains the sole application authorization decision authority
WebEngine owns adaptation and presentation gating only
WebEngine does not implement policy evaluation
WebEngine does not translate IAM management tiers into permissions
allow is not cached across subject/action/resource/context changes
deny is an AccessCore decision, not the absence of identity
adapter failure is not rewritten as deny
UI denied/hidden state is not a service-side security boundary
